## How To Create a New Widget


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000078432

Creating a custom widget can come in handy when adding completely new functionality that the software does not offer by default.

To create a new custom widget, navigate to Toolbox >> Widget Manager and click the New Widget + button:

Name the widget, add the custom code in the tab corresponding to the code language, and click Save Changes :

After saving the new widget, the module reloads and redirects back to the main Widget Manager page, where the new widget appears above the default widgets:

Once created, the custom widget can be used in two ways:

- In a sidebar: open Toolbox >> Sidebar Manager , edit the desired sidebar, search for the widget by name, and drag it into place. https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000673365

- Anywhere widgets are supported (web pages, other widgets, SEO templates): call it with its shortcode, using the widget's exact name: [widget=Widget Name] [widget=Widget Name]
